methods.label: Work outward using fractional powers
methods.explanation:
Work from the innermost cube root outward. Since \(N>1\), all bases are positive: multiplying powers of \(N\) adds their exponents, and taking a cube root divides the exponent by \(3\).

The innermost root is \(\sqrt[3]{N}=N^{1/3}\). The next root is
\[
\sqrt[3]{N\cdot N^{1/3}}
=N^{(1+1/3)/3}
=N^{4/9}.
\]
Therefore the entire expression is
\[
\sqrt[3]{N\cdot N^{4/9}}
=N^{(1+4/9)/3}
=N^{13/27}.
\]
The answer is \(N^{13/27}\), choice D.
